sn11.13:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn11.13:1.3: atha kho mahalī licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahalī licchavī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn11.13:3.1: diṭṭho kho me mahali sakko devānamindoti.
sn11.13:4.1: so hi nūna bhante sakkapaṭirūpako bhavissati
sn11.13:5.1: sakkañcāhaṃ mahali pajānāmi sakkakaraṇe ca dhamme yesañca dhammānaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā tañca pajānāmi.
sn11.13:6.1: sakko mahali devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno magho nāma māṇavo ahosi tasmā maghavāti vuccati.
sn11.13:7.1: sakko mahali devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno pure dānaṃ adāsi tasmā purindadoti vuccati. sakko mahali devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ adāsi tasmā sakkoti vuccati.
sn11.13:8.1: sakko mahali devānamindo pubbe manussabhūto samāno
sn11.13:10.1: sakko mahali devānamindo sahassampi atthānaṃ muhuttena cinteti tasmā sahassakkhoti vuccati.
sn11.13:11.1: sakkassa mahali devānamindassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpatī tasmā sujampatīti vuccati.
sn11.13:12.1: sakko mahali devānamindo devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti tasmā devānamindoti vuccati.
sn11.13:13.1: sakkassa mahali devānamindassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vattapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ yesaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā.
sn11.13:13.7: yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyaṃ muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato
sn11.13:13.9: yāvajīvaṃ akkodhano assaṃ sacepi me kodho uppajjeyya khippameva naṃ paṭivineyyanti.
sn11.13:13.10: sakkassa mahali devānamindassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vattapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ yesaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagāti.
